title: [SETUP-BUG] ML flow browser error message: "something went wrong"
body:
### System information

- **OS Platform and Distribution (e.g., Linux Ubuntu 16.04)**: Macbook ventura 13.4.1
- **MLflow installed from (source or binary)**:Jupterlab 3.5.3
- **MLflow version (run ``mlflow --version``)**:2.5.0



### Code to reproduce issue

NA

### Describe the problem

New user to mlflow. When I run my mlflow browser, the Ui wasn't there. The error mentioned below. I think I might have deleted my directory folder. how do you check the artifact location ? 
- I tried reinstalling and installing mlflow again. It doesn't work
- I tried adding back the folder in the directory. it's don't work. maybe my location is wrong too. 
- Uninstalled and installed anaconda, the mlflow browser returned the below error. 

Your advice is much appreciated. Thanks!


'''
Something went wrong

If this error persists, please report an issue [here](https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues).
'''

### Other info / logs

NA

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: It might be worthwhile to go through the tutorial here: https://<redacted-host>/docs/latest/quickstart.html and make sure that you're up to speed on all of the getting started elements for MLflow :)

I recalled that initially when I install mlflow in my Mac computer, the localhost is fine until I delete some logs.  I compare this computer and my other computer B(Localhost working) to placed back the files back same location.  it doesn't work. 

Is there any way I can uninstall mlflow together with its relevant files and do a clean mlflow installation. 
Tried in terminal # %pip install -U mlflow and pip install mlflow . It does not make a clean installation. 

Appreciate your help on this. Thanks
